countryCode.description: A two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, when present.

Address.description: A postal address for the Card's entity.

AddressComponent.description: A single component of a Card's address, such as locality or postcode.

Card.description:
JSContact Card object (version 2.0), per the RPP JSContact Profile
(draft-wullink-rpp-json §5.2.8).

CardKind.description: Kind of entity the Card represents.

EmailAddress.description: An email address for the Card's entity.

Link.description: A link related to the Card's entity.

Name.description: The name of the entity represented by the Card.

NameComponent.description: A single component of a Card's name, such as a given name or surname.

Organization.description: An organization the Card's entity is associated with.

features.description: Absent means the number MUST be treated as a voice number.

Phone.description: A phone number for the Card's entity.

PhoneFeatures.description: Feature flags for a phone number, e.g. voice, fax, text.
